what_they_do: SAMMY Labs originally built a screen-aware AI agent (voice interaction, screen capture, semantic memory) that auto-generates product walkthroughs, documentation, and onboarding flows as an app's UI changes, replacing manual doc-writing and support-ticket triage for SaaS onboarding and customer success teams. The public site and YC profile now lead with a repositioned pitch: "computational law for AI agents," giving deterministic, audit-tracked answers to legal and compliance questions instead of an LLM's best guess, aimed at regulated industries and regulators directly. The underlying screen/voice/memory tech (confirmed on docs.sammylabs.com) appears unchanged; the go-to-market framing has shifted from documentation automation to agent governance/compliance.
vertical: Legal & compliance AI for agents (pivoted from documentation/product-onboarding automation)
theme_fit_rationale: Primary fit is Theme 3 (Building software for agents): SAMMY now explicitly frames its product as infrastructure built for AI agents as the end user ("computational law for AI agents"), not a human-facing tool, matching the theme's governance use case. Secondary fit is Theme 9 (Agentic security infrastructure): the core new value prop is a deterministic, auditable layer that constrains/checks what an agent is allowed to conclude or do on legal/compliance questions, with a full audit trail, which maps directly to the theme's audit trails and governance use cases.
workflow_artifacts: audit trail logs for agent legal/compliance Q&A
